# ChillZone (Chill Zone) Gateshead

> ChillZone — also written "Chill Zone" — is a UK registered charity (number 1214818) in Gateshead, Tyne and Wear. It creates a safe, welcoming and empowering space for Jewish young people: therapeutic support, workshops, activities and friendship.

Also known as: ChillZone Gateshead, Chill Zone Gateshead, ChillZone GHD, chillzone.org.uk

- [Home](/): Mission, what we do, and how to get involved.
- [Impact](/impact): How The National Lottery Community Fund funding helped young women in Gateshead.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Photos from ChillZone events, workshops and activities.
- [Contact](/contact): Email, phone and WhatsApp contact details.
